description: Parking Meters is a dataset listed in City of Boston open data portal (Analyze Boston), an open data portal, published or maintained by Boston Maps. City of Boston parking meters. Updated and maintained by Boston Transportation Department (BTD) Parking Clerk. Coverage: Boston, Massachusetts. The portal files it under the publisher Boston Maps. Its tags are boston, bostonmaps, bparc, btd, ckan. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License (PDDL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-boston-portal.
